issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a subroutine named set_pixel, but the solution implementation defines a function named write_pixel while main calls set_pixel. This name mismatch (set_pixel vs write_pixel) means the solution does not actually implement the required symbol and will confuse students (they will not find the implementation for set_pixel) and will cause assembly/link errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent: rename the solution's write_pixel label to set_pixel (or change the call sites to call write_pixel) so that the solution provides the expected set_pixel symbol. Ensure the template's set_pixel stub matches the implemented name in the solution.
